description: Defines the QuicIdleNetworkDetector class for detecting handshake and idle network timeouts in QUIC connections, including related delegate interface and internal state management.

classes.name: quic::QuicIdleNetworkDetector
classes.description: Detects handshake timeout and idle network timeout, manages detection alarms, and notifies delegate on events.

classes.name: quic::QuicIdleNetworkDetector::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when handshake times out, idle network is detected, or bandwidth update alarms.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing detector with delegate, current time, arena, alarm factory, and context.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm triggers for timeout detection.

methods.name: SetTimeouts
methods.description: Sets handshake and idle network timeouts.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates state when a packet is sent, possibly shortening idle timeout.

methods.name: OnPacketReceived
methods.description: Updates state when a packet is received.

methods.name: GetIdleNetworkDeadline
methods.description: Returns the deadline for idle network detection.
